<b>Caranids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are weak fliers that are common throughout the lowlands of [[Pharloom]].<ref>Caranid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Common winged bug of the lowlands. Generally docile, but will attack if threats come close."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Flies aimlessly and slowly until they spot [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], at which point they fly towards her at slow speed, trying to fly into her and deal {{Damage|1}} on contact. If Hornet moves sufficiently far away or moves for long enough, they stop following her.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Caranids have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
*Rumbling, crackling...
*Shells are strong...

*Digging, hiding...
*Claws are sharp...
}}

== Location ==
Caranids can be mainly found throughout [[the Marrow]], [[Deep Docks]], and [[Far Fields]]. They also appear in the upper portion of [[Bone Bottom]], [[Memorium]], and the [[Chapel of the Beast]] within [[Hunter's March]], where they can also be summoned by a [[Savage Beastfly]]. Once the Savage Beastfly is defeated, one Caranid starts to spawn in the corridor below its arena.

After [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]] are defeated, three Caranids appear in the southeastern area of the Deep Docks, in the room where [[Forebrother Gron]] could previously be encountered. Two Caranids can be found harassing [[Tipp]] in the upper portion of Bone Bottom during the <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i> [[wish]].
